open_points.subject: backup-location startup probe
open_points.text: the environment is read by `runtime_settings` alone (§6.11), and `configuration` checks what it loaded;
open_points.question: Which module performs A17's writable-backup-location probe and creates/removes its temporary file: `configuration`, `backups`, or `instance_lifecycle` calling `backups`?
options: `configuration` performs the probe, despite the rule that only `backups` names or removes files in the backup location
`backups` owns the probe and `instance_lifecycle` invokes it after configuration validation
open_points.default_guess: `backups` owns the file operation and exposes a startup check that `instance_lifecycle` invokes; `configuration` checks only the loaded values and path relationship.

open_points.subject: new-store temporary-file lifecycle
open_points.text: Only `store` opens a SQLite database — the store's, and the decrypted copy of a backup that `backups` hands it by path to check — and only `backups` names, renames or deletes a file in the backup location; `store` writes and opens one there only at the temporary path `backups` names for it.
open_points.question: Which module owns A17's removal of the store temporary file, creation of a new store under that name, and rename into place: `configuration`, `store`, or `instance_lifecycle`?
options: `configuration` owns it as part of A17 startup checking
`instance_lifecycle` performs the filesystem operations and asks `store` only to initialize and check SQLite
open_points.default_guess: `store` owns creation, checking, removal and rename of the store and its temporary file; `instance_lifecycle` sequences the call after `configuration` succeeds.
